item.title: Using dynamic SQL statements from PL/SQL
item.description: Sometimes you need to execute dynamic SQL statements. Starting from Oracle8i you can accomplish this task using the EXECUTE IMMEDIATE statement. Here are three examples of how you can take advantage of this great statement. In this first example I showed how you can use EXECUTE IMMEDIATE to execute…
